answer: Sybil resistance begins when each agent deposits bonded stake and evaluates the epoch polynomial to obtain a rate-limited nullifier. In pulse, willow, and haven epochs, a valid message proves membership without exposing identity; repeating a nullifier produces distinct Shamir shares that reconstruct the private key, providing cryptographic evidence for immediate, automatic slashing of the bonded collateral. This makes duplicate participation costly and attributable rather than merely detectable.
